Build M5: unified player-turn/activation turn model (standard 3-4P unchanged) + 2-player double-racer variant (reveal 2 each, run both per turn, first-turn-one-racer, points tiebreak). 2P enabled in menu. 29 tests green incl. 2P full-match sim; lint/build/dev green.

Build M6 (push to 32/36): added Leaptoad (leap occupied), Skipper+Inchworm (turn-order via goNext), Genius (predict->extra turn), Twin+Egg (copiedPowerId, auto-pick), Dicemonger (universal reroll + reaction), Mastermind (predict winner -> finish 2nd). 48 unit tests + e2e green; lint/build green.
